messages:
ben-arch: quick follow-up from the surge-resilience RFC — we need a concrete migration play for a region that suddenly exceeds capacity while honoring data residency. thinking: preflight shadow-writes + local ack, async reconcile to primary. tradeoffs?

oliver-sre: shadow-writes reduce user-visible errors but double write load. we need a throttle threshold. what headroom are we budgeting? :thinking:

ben-arch: target is 2x normal peak for short bursts (<=5m) before we start tiered routing. if >5m we trigger a staged redirect.

anya-ml: kv-cache coherence will be messy — shadow-writes mean stale reads at nearby regions. suggest we version writes and expose a small stale window to clients, then drain with background reconcile.

sara-eng: API change required — add X-Redwood-Residency header to allow customers to opt into "relaxed" mode during surge. default stays strict. we should document fallback semantics clearly.

ben-arch: agreed. header proposal: `X-Redwood-Residency: strict|relaxed` and server signals with `Rescue-Mode:shadow` when in migration.

oliver-sre: also need a short lease transfer protocol to avoid split-writes. something like: acquire temporary regional lease -> shadow-write locally -> async lease handoff when stable. avoid blocking normal low-latency reads.

anya-ml: for model-backed features, staleness impacts quality heavily. recommend we mark responses with `x-output-confidence` and surface degraded-quality alerts to Optimize so customers can see regressions.

ben-arch: good point. add quality telemetry hooks in the rollout.

ben-arch: minimal policy example to discuss in RFC follow-up:
```
route_policy:
  - name: local_prefer
    priority: [local, nearby, fallback]
    residency_enforce: true
    fallback_mode: shadow_write
    max_grace_ms: 300000
```

sara-eng: can we make `fallback_mode` pluggable per-tenant? enterprise tenants may want failover=false.

oliver-sre: yes per-tenant flags + global circuit breaker. need metrics: `shadow_write_rate`, `shadow_write_failures`, `migration_lag_ms`, `lease_swap_rate`.

tomas: add rollout plan: 1) sim in staging with 50% synthetic surge 2) canary 5% traffic 3) monitor metrics 4) progressive 25/50/100. define abort thresholds.

deploy-bot: simulation job #342 queued (config: 2x RPS peak, 5m sustained). logs -> https://ci.internal/sim/342

anya-ml: simulation should include KV cache churn and model latency tails — otherwise we miss emergent regressions.

ben-arch: noted. will update sim to include cache churn.

oliver-sre: operational runbook needs quick rollback: scaffolded API header to force strict residency and disable shadow mode per-tenant + emergency kill-switch at edge proxy.

ben-arch: I'll draft runbook section and open RFC follow-up PR with the policy sample, header spec, metrics list, and rollout steps. tagging @sara-eng to review header wording.

sara-eng: will review, also push a short customer-facing note template for enterprise customers.

ben-arch: thanks folks — follow-up PR and runbook link coming later today. :thumbsup:
